review_candidates.description: Job Description Background: We are seeking a skilled and experienced Group Cash Transfer (GCT) Manager to oversee and manage all aspects of our Group Cash Transfer programmes. Within the Cash & Market thematic team, the GCT Manager will be responsible for designing, implementing, and monitoring group cash transfer initiatives in collaboration with Core Competency Specialists and local stakeholders, including Emergency Response Rooms, CBOs, NGOs and community partners. The ideal candidate will have strong leadership, project management and financial management skills, along with a deep understanding of humanitarian principles and best practices in cash transfer programming. What you will do: Programme Design and Planning Lead the design and development of group cash transfer programmes, ensuring alignment with organisational goals and objectives. In consultation with stakeholders and line management, conduct assessments and analysis to identify target communities and beneficiaries, as well as their specific needs and preferences. Collaborate with stakeholders to develop detailed implementation plans, timelines and budgets for programme activities. Partnership Management Identify and establish partnerships with local Emergency Response Rooms (ERRs), NGOs, community-based organisations (CBOs), government agencies and other relevant stakeholders. Build and maintain strong relationships with Area Managers, Area Program Managers, Core Competency (CC) Specialists, partners, and stakeholders, ensuring effective communication, collaboration and coordination throughout programme implementation. Provide technical guidance and support to partners in the planning, implementation, and monitoring of group cash transfer activities. Programme Implementation Oversee the implementation of group cash transfer programmes, ensuring adherence to programme design, standards, and protocols. Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate programme activities, including fund transfers, beneficiary registration, cash distribution and monitoring. Monitor programme progress and performance, identify challenges and opportunities, and take corrective action as needed to achieve programme objectives. Coordinate with the M&E unit and CC Specialists on building and regularly updating the Capacity Building Programme targeting local responders. Financial Management Develop and manage programme budgets, ensuring accurate forecasting, expenditure tracking, and compliance with the internal standards of the Risk and Compliance section, donor requirements and financial regulations. Monitor cash flow processes and financial transactions related to group cash transfer activities and ensure timely and efficient use of funds. Training, Capacity Building and Awareness Raising Develop training materials and resources for programme staff, partners and community members on group cash transfer methodologies, financial management and programme implementation. Deliver training sessions and capacity-building activities, ensuring that participants have the skills and knowledge to implement and manage group cash transfer programmes effectively. Conduct awareness-raising campaigns and community engagement activities to promote understanding of group cash transfer programmes, encourage participation, and address potential misconceptions or concerns. Monitoring, Evaluation and Learning Develop and implement monitoring and evaluation plans to assess programme effectiveness, efficiency, and impact. Collect and analyse data on programme outputs and outcomes, and use findings to inform programme adjustments and improvements. Facilitate learning and knowledge sharing among programme staff, partners and stakeholders to promote continuous improvement and innovation. Project Staff Management Supervise, coach and mentor project staff, ensuring clear roles, workplans and performance objectives, and conduct regular performance reviews. Plan and allocate staff across projects and locations, including Country Office, Areas Offices in Darfurs, Kordofans. Support recruitment, onboarding and professional development of project staff, and identify capacity gaps and training needs. Excellent communication, negotiation and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse stakeholders. Ability to work independently, under pressure and with minimal guidance, in a challenging and dynamic environment. Commitment to the organisation's mission, vision and values. About the Role We are looking for a Content Marketing Manager to join our Marketing and Communications team at our Milan headquarters, reporting to the Global Marketing and Communications Director. You’ll be responsible for turning Energy Dome’s story into compelling content across every format and channel: copy, graphic design, video and web. This is a hands-on role. Your focus is execution: you’ll set priorities and plans, then produce a large share of the work yourself, from writing and designing to editing video and building web pages, while coordinating agencies, freelancers and developers when the job calls for it. You’ll communicate fluently across every audience we speak to, from utilities, hyperscalers and data centre developers to policymakers, investors and local communities, in the US, Europe, Australia and India. You’ll also be responsible for internal communications, including managing our company intranet. While this is a marketing role, you’ll work very closely with HR. The role is based in Milan with a hybrid work model. Key Responsibilities Brand, Messaging & Content · Own Energy Dome’s brand identity and tone of voice, ensuring consistency across every channel and touchpoint. · Write and edit high-impact copy for the website, LinkedIn, newsletters, brochures, case studies, presentations and press materials. · Adapt our messaging to each audience and market, translating complex technology into clear, compelling stories. · Run the editorial calendar, proactively spotting news hooks and opportunities and turning them into content. Graphic Design · Design brochures, pitch decks, infographics, reports, trade show booths, signage and social media assets using Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop). · Develop and maintain brand guidelines and templates, acting as the quality gate for all visual output from agencies and freelancers. · Turn technical content, project data and performance figures into clear, impactful visuals. Video Production · Manage and execute the full post-production workflow, from editing to motion graphics, subtitles and multi-format delivery, briefing external agencies and freelancers when needed. Website & Digital · Own our WordPress website and project microsites, from structure, UX and copy to updates, SEO and performance. · Work hands-on in WordPress day-to-day and coordinate web developers on larger projects. · Track performance across web and social channels and use the data to improve what we publish. Internal Communications · Plan and deliver internal communications, from company announcements and leadership messages to the internal newsletter and all-hands materials, keeping colleagues across our offices and project sites informed and engaged. · Manage the company intranet, keeping its content current, useful and easy to navigate. · Work very closely with HR on internal initiatives, onboarding materials, culture content and employer branding. Events, Sales Enablement & Operations · In collaboration with our Event Manager, plan and coordinate Energy Dome’s brand presence at international conferences and trade shows from a creative execution standpoint, including booth design, collateral, etc. · Equip business development teams with pitch decks, one-pagers and case studies that help win over sophisticated buyers. · Manage specific project budgets, agencies, freelancers and suppliers, keeping multiple projects on time and on budget. · Help hire, onboard and mentor new team members as the marketing team grows. Qualifications Required · At least 5+ years of experience in the role, with focus on content or creative roles, including experience leading projects, people and/or agencies. · Degree in marketing, communications, design or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. · Excellent copywriting skills (in English): a versatile writer able to make complex topics simple and to adapt tone across audiences and channels. · Advanced graphic design skills: expert command of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop), with a strong eye for layout, typography and brand consistency. · Advanced video editing skills: expert command of Adobe Premiere Pro, with hands-on experience editing video (including interviews) from both an aesthetic and a technical standpoint. · Strong WordPress skills: able to build, update and optimise pages independently and to work effectively with web developers. · English at C2 (fully proficient) or native level, with impeccable writing and grammar. · A strong portfolio showcasing your copywriting, graphic design, video and web work (please include a link with your application). · Proven project management skills: able to run multiple creative and non-creative projects in parallel, on time and on budget. · International experience and the ability to work effectively in multicultural teams. · A proactive self-starter who thrives in a fast-moving, mission-driven scale-up. Desirable · Experience in the energy, utilities, infrastructure or cleantech sectors, ideally in B2B marketing. · Technical copywriting experience. · Motion graphics skills (Adobe After Effects) and photography experience. · PR and media relations experience, including drafting press releases and working with PR agencies. · Experience in internal communications and intranet management, ideally working closely with HR. · Experience organising international conferences, exhibitions and corporate events. · Confident use of generative AI tools to speed up research, writing, design and video workflows, without compromising quality or accuracy. · Working knowledge of Italian. Personal Skills Proactivity, ownership and attention to detail. We are looking for an extremely proactive self-starter: someone who anticipates needs, spots opportunities and acts on them without waiting to be asked, and who takes full ownership of results. You lead by example and combine strategic thinking with a genuinely hands-on approach, equally comfortable presenting a plan to senior leadership and editing a video or fixing a web page yourself. We appreciate autonomous people with an entrepreneurial approach, eager to get involved, able to make decisions and who demonstrate flexibility and curiosity. Company’s Culture and Further Opportunities Energy Dome is a fast-growing company and we are constantly looking for professionals who want to grow with us and help structure our processes and projects. Here you will have a concrete opportunity to prove yourself and have responsibilities, both technical and managerial, with room to grow vertically or horizontally depending on the company’s needs and your preferences. We value ownership, collaboration, pragmatism and a hands-on approach. We love ambitious, motivated and humble people who are passionate about their work, and we invest in our people as much as they invest in us. If you require reasonable accommodation during the selection process, please let us know. We are committed to ensuring a fair and accessible hiring process.
